as_of_content:
'''Unstoppable''' is an ability that makes a Bot temporarily shrug off the impact of attacks, allowing him to counterattack quicker but still take damage.

==Bots with Unstoppable==
* [[Grimlock]] (when using heavies)
* [[Motormaster]] (Dashing and Special 2)
* [[Megatron]] (when he’s knocked down sometimes)
* [[Megatron (ROTF)]] (when health drops at 80, 60 and 40%) 
*[[Ramjet]] (when using heavy attacks)
*[[Sharkticon#Sharkticon Brawler|Sharkticon Brawler]] (Special 2)
*[[Tantrum]] (while blocking and special 3)
==Mods==
*[[Exo-Filter]]
[[Category:Abilities]]
